Container.Name: speaches-stt
Container.Overview: The fleet's listener: speech-to-text (Whisper, OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions) on Tower01's RTX A2000. The model is kept loaded (STT_MODEL_TTL=-1) and takes about 1.6 GB of the card; Jellyfin transcoding keeps first claim on the rest. Voices (Chatterbox, Kokoro) run on Tower04, not here. API at http://tower01:8790. Added 2026-11-17.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Host port for the speech-to-text API (same number the old Tower03 copy used).

Config.Name: Model cache
Config.Description: Downloaded speech models (Hugging Face hub cache).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID (nvidia-smi -L). Default = Tower01 RTX A2000.

Config.Name: Keep listening model loaded
Config.Description: Seconds a speech-to-text model stays on the card after its last use. -1 = never unload (locked). 300 = unload after five idle minutes.
